comment: Live oscilloscope on the pedal screen (MS-70CDR 2.10). Pass-through; draws the incoming signal into its own cover at up to ~30 fps (frame composed in the arena, imageInfo picture pointer swapped, UI redraw woken). Method: docs/pedal-research/animated-covers.md; firmware facts from Leemuzhko's ZOOM_development SDK (credited, own code).

params.name: Time
params.comment: Time across the screen: 1-64 samples per column (2.9-186 ms).

params.name: Gain
params.comment: Vertical zoom, x0.5 to x32 (default x2.5).
